experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2494:./experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:1160:experiments/results.md:1667:- **结论**：机制**有明确相对信号**，pose-anchored DINO correspondence 在重遮挡上 3-4 倍超整图基准且 pose 锚定占绝对主导 → kill-switch 命中正向条件，**值得 exp324b 上轻量 part-projection 头 / LoRA**。
experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2505:./experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:1181:experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:14:Review two files for a person-ReID experiment exp324b: experiments/exp324b/design.md and scripts/exp324b_train_head.py (it imports helpers from scripts/exp324_dino.py — read that for context). Setup: FROZEN DINOv2-base dense tokens, pose-anchored into 5 body parts (cached), then a LIGHTWEIGHT shared Linear(768->512)+BNNeck+classifier head (~413K params, DINO never back-propped). Loss = ID CrossEntropy on BNNeck feat + batch-hard SOFT-MARGIN triplet on pre-BN global feat (global = masked-mean over visible projected parts), weight 1:1. PK sampler P=16 x K=4 = BS64. Eval = two distmats: global cosine + mutually-visible part-MaxSim (L2-normalized projected parts); mAP/R1 on ALL query and HEAVY-OCC (query pose visibility_binary.sum()<=8). Goal: lift exp324's frozen 1.86 heavy-occ mAP via training the head. Review line-by-line: bugs / runtime errors / shape-device-dtype mismatches / edge cases (zero-visible-part images, NaN); train/test asymmetry (head is supervised via GLOBAL masked-mean feature but tested via per-part normalized part-MaxSim — is this coupling sound? should there be a part-level loss?); triplet correctness (pos/neg masks, hardest mining, soft-margin); PK sampler correctness; eval correctness (same-pid-same-cam exclusion, heavy-occ mask slicing, query/gallery pose split mapping); single-variable isolation vs exp324; no LR scheduler concern. Use web search to check novelty/precedent of 'frozen foundation-model features + lightweight head + pose-part matching for occluded person ReID'. Output: Verdict (approve / needs-attention) + findings with severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low).

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4138:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2001:./ondisk_pivot.md:380:| (c) hard-negative mining / anti-hub margin / proxy metric learning | **部分撞车，杀伤最大** | ReID hard mining/HAP2S/MS loss 主要按 anchor-local difficulty/相似度加权，不是全局误吸附 in-degree。**但 HAL 和 NeighborRetr 已经非常接近“训练端 hubness-aware loss + memory/global stats”**，只是任务是图文/跨模态检索，不是 person ReID。 | HAL 用 memory bank 和 kNN query 统计 hub，并在训练 loss 中加权；NeighborRetr 明确 bad/good hubs、centrality、memory bank、训练端缓解 hubness。链接：[HAL](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10097), [NeighborRetr](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10526), [HAP2S ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.11206), [MS Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.06627) | 9 |

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1474:experiments/exp347_noparam_deocc/claude_review.md:32:- exp347 路径返回（`pose_backbone_model.py:894-895`）：`cls_score, global_feat, featmaps, None, {'clip_id_loss': ...}`。携带的特征是 `global_feat`（raw GAP, 501-502 行），**不是** `feat_for_clip`。de-occluded 特征**仅**用于 CLIP 对齐 loss，绝不做描述子或 triplet anchor。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1734:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:1:# 实验 SMPL-Anchor VI-ReID (v0 preliminary) — SMPL 几何当模态无关锚
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1735:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:8:- ★洞察: **SMPL 3D 几何(姿态参数 + 投影关节 + mesh)是从人体结构恢复的, 与外观(颜色/热强度)无关 → 天然模态不变**。比 2D 轮廓更"光谱无关"(纯几何, RGB/IR 投影一致, 不受 IR 边缘检测退化影响)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1736:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:9:- ★空白: 文献里没人用 **SMPL 3D 几何**当 VI-ReID 模态锚(轮廓/体形有人做, 3D mesh 几何是空白)。团队有 SMPL 基建(ROMP/SMPLer-X)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1737:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:10:- 区别于团队 exp333(SMPL-β 随机判负): 这里用**几何(姿态/关节)做结构对齐锚**, 不是 β 当身份特征。绕开 exp333 死因。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1738:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:13:SMPL 3D 几何当**训练期特权(LUPI)模态共享锚**, 把同人的 RGB/IR 特征拉到同一几何上 → 缩小模态 gap → VI-ReID 涨点; 且增益来自几何对齐(非通用正则, 由 shuffle 对照证伪)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1739:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:16:1. **离线**: 对 RGB 和 IR 行人 crop 各跑 SMPL fit(ROMP/SMPLer-X) → 几何(姿态参数 / 投影 2D 关节热图 / mesh 顶点)。缓存成 .pth。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1740:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:17:2. **训练**: 共享 backbone(Swin-Small, 团队资产)双流(RGB/IR)→ baseline ID+triplet loss + **SMPL 几何对齐 loss**: 同人 RGB/IR 特征对齐到共享几何(privileged 监督)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1741:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:18:3. **测试**: 只用 RGB/IR encoder, **丢 SMPL** → 单 embedding 零外部(LUPI 干净口径)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1742:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:22:**低对比 IR 图上 SMPL 能不能 fit 准?** 取 RegDB / SYSU-MM01 的 IR crop 样本(~200), 跑 SMPL fit, 量: valid rate / 2D 关节 reprojection error / 人工视觉检查 N 张。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1743:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:23:- fit 是 garbage(valid<60% 或 reproj 大) → **SMPL-anchor 死**, 转 Swin-VI 机制(领域无 Swin 赢家那条)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1744:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:26:## ★★ kill-switch 结果 (2026-06-22): SMPL 锚 **死**
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1745:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:32:**判定: 2D pose 在热成像上完全 OOD(所有 pose/SMPL 工具都 RGB 训), IR 提不出人体几何。SMPL 几何锚需两模态都提几何 → 死。** 加上 RegDB RGB/IR 非同时拍(几何不对应), 双重证死。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1757:experiments/exp327_dinov3/design.md:1:# 实验 exp327: DINOv3 / DINOv2-with-registers pose-anchored part-MaxSim 训练-free 天花板 check
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1761:experiments/exp327_dinov3/design.md:10:- DINOv3（2025）与 DINOv2-with-registers 都改进了 dense feature 质量：registers 去掉了 ViT 的 high-norm artifact token（更干净的 patch 特征），DINOv3 用更大数据 + Gram anchoring 进一步提纯 dense 特征。**若更干净的 dense 对应能直接抬训练-free 重遮挡 mAP，则更强冻结源的天花板更高，值得优先上头。**

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1770:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/baseline_integration_plan.md:28:### (b) SMPL 几何对齐(LUPI, 测试丢 SMPL)
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1771:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/baseline_integration_plan.md:36:1. **IR 上 SMPL 是 OOD**(ROMP 训于 RGB, 热成像单通道关节可能不可靠; SYSU/RegDB 无像素对齐 RGB-IR 同瞬间对)=核心科学风险。→ kill-switch 先跑。定位为"姿态/视角兼容性门控 + 各模态独立几何", 低置信 SMPL confidence-gating 跳过。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6764:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1253:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1857:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_14.txt:1:结论先放前面：**CLIP/DINO/SAM 直接当 backbone、prompt learner、text anchor、SAM 遮挡增强、LVLM 生成语义 token 这条线基本红了**。2024-2026 已经有 CLIP 语义注入 VI-ReID、CLIP selective prompt tuning、LVLM-ReID、LLaVA/MLLM interactive ReID、SAM occlusion augmentation、KPR promptable ReID 等工作在占位。继续“导入 FM 提精度”不建议碰。参考：CSDN/CLIP-VIReID 已做语义桥接与 prompt learner([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.05806))，SCING 做 selective cross-modal prompt tuning([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00506))，LVLM-ReID 做 LVLM semantic token([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18111))，LLaVA-ReID/ICL 已做交互式文本 ReID([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.10174))，DPEFormer 已用 SAM 做 realistic occlusion augmentation([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435))。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1514:experiments/exp322/design.md:26:- **数据流**：anchor crop x（目标 pid=y）→ 从同 batch 不同 ID y'≠y 抠 pose-masked 人体块 → pose-aware 贴到目标人体边缘（制造 **overlap** 非 covering）得污染图 x̃ → 生成 multi-person heatmap（person-0=y, person-1=y'）+ 记录 distractor 真实 pid y' → backbone（可选 attribution gate）→ (a) **不变性锚**：f(x̃) global+part 经 CE/triplet 监督到 y；(b) **反事实对比锚**：triplet(anchor=f(x̃)目标, positive=同 y 另一图, negative=x̃ 内部 distractor pooled 表征)；(c) **exact dedup**（已知 pid + bbox IoU 跳过重叠/同人样本）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_4.md:17139:../../cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3784:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:65:2. **opposite-view retrieval loss**(`OVLIHead.loss`): batch 内, anchor(view v)的 positive = 同 pid 的 **opposite-view(1-v)** 样本, negative = 其它 pid 的 opposite-view 样本; **同视角样本完全排除出候选**(纯跨视角目标)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_4.md:17152:../../cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3797:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:89:- **本地隔离 numeric smoke test(导入仓库真实 OVLIHead, 非副本)全过**: token shape (64,32,256) 逐 token L2-norm; sym_MaxSim 对称、self 对角≈1; 正常 batch loss 有限>0 且梯度回流 **proj.weight + global feat**; all-same-view batch loss=0 不崩; 某 pid 无 opp 正样本时该 anchor 被排除、loss 仍有限、grad 有限; fp16 cached map→fp32 token; AdamW 实际推动 proj 权重。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_4.md:17158:../../cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3939:experiments/cross_view_cargo/design.md:15:1. **batch 采样统计**: CARGO train 每 pid 的 aerial/ground 图数; 双视角 pid 占比; 模拟 RandomIdentitySampler(P=16×K=4)1000 batch, anchor 有 opposite-view positive 的比例。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_4.md:17160:../../cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3941:experiments/cross_view_cargo/design.md:46:- 模拟**真实 RandomIdentitySampler**(P16×K4)1000 batch: **anchor 有 opposite-view 正样本占 88.0%**(≥1 同 ID 正样本 100%); 每 anchor opp-view 正样本 mean=1.51, 仅 12% anchor 为 0。→ 远高于 <70% 稀缺阈值, **跨视角正对在标准 batch 里并不稀缺**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_4.md:17177:../../cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:5053:- **Medium:** OVLI loss can silently have reduced effective signal because `RandomIdentitySampler` samples `K` images per PID but does not force opposite-view composition: [cargo_dataset.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/afd_reid/cargo_dataset.py:226). The loss correctly skips anchors without both opposite-view positive and negative candidates: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:316), but logs only loss/pos/neg/gap: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:677). Add `valid_anchor_frac`, `pos_per_valid`, `neg_per_valid` before long training so low OVLI loss is not confused with “no valid anchors.”

The loss correctly skips anchors without both opposite-view positive and negative candidates: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:316), but logs only loss/pos/neg/gap: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:677). experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3986:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1253:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1857:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_14.txt:1:结论先放前面：**CLIP/DINO/SAM 直接当 backbone、prompt learner、text anchor、SAM 遮挡增强、LVLM 生成语义 token 这条线基本红了**。2024-2026 已经有 CLIP 语义注入 VI-ReID、CLIP selective prompt tuning、LVLM-ReID、LLaVA/MLLM interactive ReID、SAM occlusion augmentation、KPR promptable ReID 等工作在占位。继续“导入 FM 提精度”不建议碰。参考：CSDN/CLIP-VIReID 已做语义桥接与 prompt learner([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.05806))，SCING 做 selective cross-modal prompt tuning([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00506))，LVLM-ReID 做 LVLM semantic token([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18111))，LLaVA-ReID/ICL 已做交互式文本 ReID([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.10174))，DPEFormer 已用 SAM 做 realistic occlusion augmentation([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435))。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4526:experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:14:Review two files for a person-ReID experiment exp324b: experiments/exp324b/design.md and scripts/exp324b_train_head.py (it imports helpers from scripts/exp324_dino.py — read that for context). Setup: FROZEN DINOv2-base dense tokens, pose-anchored into 5 body parts (cached), then a LIGHTWEIGHT shared Linear(768->512)+BNNeck+classifier head (~413K params, DINO never back-propped). Loss = ID CrossEntropy on BNNeck feat + batch-hard SOFT-MARGIN triplet on pre-BN global feat (global = masked-mean over visible projected parts), weight 1:1. PK sampler P=16 x K=4 = BS64. Eval = two distmats: global cosine + mutually-visible part-MaxSim (L2-normalized projected parts); mAP/R1 on ALL query and HEAVY-OCC (query pose visibility_binary.sum()<=8). Goal: lift exp324's frozen 1.86 heavy-occ mAP via training the head. Review line-by-line: bugs / runtime errors / shape-device-dtype mismatches / edge cases (zero-visible-part images, NaN); train/test asymmetry (head is supervised via GLOBAL masked-mean feature but tested via per-part normalized part-MaxSim — is this coupling sound? should there be a part-level loss?); triplet correctness (pos/neg masks, hardest mining, soft-margin); PK sampler correctness; eval correctness (same-pid-same-cam exclusion, heavy-occ mask slicing, query/gallery pose split mapping); single-variable isolation vs exp324; no LR scheduler concern. Use web search to check novelty/precedent of 'frozen foundation-model features + lightweight head + pose-part matching for occluded person ReID'. Output: Verdict (approve / needs-attention) + findings with severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low).

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4725:experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:3276:./experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:14:Review two files for a person-ReID experiment exp324b: experiments/exp324b/design.md and scripts/exp324b_train_head.py (it imports helpers from scripts/exp324_dino.py — read that for context). Setup: FROZEN DINOv2-base dense tokens, pose-anchored into 5 body parts (cached), then a LIGHTWEIGHT shared Linear(768->512)+BNNeck+classifier head (~413K params, DINO never back-propped). Loss = ID CrossEntropy on BNNeck feat + batch-hard SOFT-MARGIN triplet on pre-BN global feat (global = masked-mean over visible projected parts), weight 1:1. PK sampler P=16 x K=4 = BS64. Eval = two distmats: global cosine + mutually-visible part-MaxSim (L2-normalized projected parts); mAP/R1 on ALL query and HEAVY-OCC (query pose visibility_binary.sum()<=8). Goal: lift exp324's frozen 1.86 heavy-occ mAP via training the head. Review line-by-line: bugs / runtime errors / shape-device-dtype mismatches / edge cases (zero-visible-part images, NaN); train/test asymmetry (head is supervised via GLOBAL masked-mean feature but tested via per-part normalized part-MaxSim — is this coupling sound? should there be a part-level loss?); triplet correctness (pos/neg masks, hardest mining, soft-margin); PK sampler correctness; eval correctness (same-pid-same-cam exclusion, heavy-occ mask slicing, query/gallery pose split mapping); single-variable isolation vs exp324; no LR scheduler concern. Use web search to check novelty/precedent of 'frozen foundation-model features + lightweight head + pose-part matching for occluded person ReID'. Output: Verdict (approve / needs-attention) + findings with severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low).

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:5654:   - `L_visible_anchor`: 可见 part 不许被改坏，防止 completion 过度平滑。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:5655:   - `L_dino/solider_anchor`: 对可见区域蒸馏原始 backbone/DINOv2 dense feature，防 catastrophic forgetting。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8031:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:141:"mechanism": "Per frame, an off-the-shelf 3D human reconstruction (HMR/SMPL) produces a pedestrian mesh, which is converted to a point cloud and back-projected with image RGB; a detection-free PointPillar backbone encodes it into a pseudo-image (\"pillar-based feature\") whose dimensions are aligned with 2D ResNet image features. A Cross-Modal Fusion (CMF) module uses deformable cross-attention where pillar features are queries and 2D-to-3D mapping gives reference points, so sampling locations on the image are anchored at projected pedestrian body positions. A separate Shape-aware Spatial-Temporal Interaction (SSTI) module runs parallel spatial/temporal self-attention over SMPL shape parameters (β) to form a video-level 3D-shape descriptor; CMF fusion features (after temporal aggregation) and the SSTI shape feature are concatenated as the final representation, trained with cross-entropy + triplet.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8200:experiments/exp131/claude_review_v2.md:66:1. **Softmax 稀释**（中风险）：queue 填满后，每个 anchor 的 neg 候选从 ~48 暴增到 ~304。`_distill_subset` 中 `F.log_softmax(s_logits, dim=0)` 在全量 batch+queue 上归一化，分布更平坦，每个 pair 的 KL 信号被稀释。这可能抵消 coverage 增益。**监控指标**：观察 `csrd_qr`（queue ratio）和 CSRD loss 值变化。
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8220:experiments/exp131/claude_review.md:68:2. **Softmax 稀释**: `_distill_subset` 中 KL 的 softmax 在 `dim=0` 上对 batch+queue relations 一起归一化。当 queue 填满后，一个 anchor 的 neg 候选从 ~48 个暴增到 ~300 个，softmax distribution 变得更平坦，每个 pair 的信号被稀释。这可能抵消 coverage 增益。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:4:> 大家以为强 ReID 失败来自"某个 query 没匹配好"（pairwise 相似度病），其实是 **少数 gallery 样本变成很多 query 的吸附点**——错误是 **many-to-one 的图库拓扑病**。ReID 不是独立 query-gallery pair matching，而是 **directed kNN graph retrieval**；隐藏变量不是 hard-negative distance，而是 gallery 的 **负向 in-degree / hub mass**（≠hard negative：hard 是对一个 anchor 近；hub 是对**很多不同身份**都近，是全局误吸附点）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:30:→ 全过 = hub-mass 隐藏变量真实且独立 → 写训练版（Hub-Aware Retrieval Embedding: memory bank 存 cross-ID top-k in-degree, anti-hub margin, negative 权重从"离anchor近"改"是否全局误吸附点", 测试仍单 embedding 不变 test-time trick, beat triplet/k-reciprocal/camera-aware）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/video_feasibility.md:575:我们要做 ReID 方法 **Gallery Hubness ReID**。重定义: 强 ReID 失败不是 pairwise 相似度病, 而是**少数 gallery 样本变成很多不同身份 query 的吸附点**(负向 in-degree / hub mass)=many-to-one 图库拓扑病。机制: 训练端 anti-hub margin(对全局误吸附 gallery 降权), memory bank 存 cross-ID top-k in-degree, negative 权重从'离anchor近'改'是否全局误吸附点', 测试仍单 embedding(不变 test-time trick)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/video_feasibility.md:597:web search: Proxy-NCA metric learning proxy anchor loss hard negative mining hubness
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/video_feasibility.md:662:| (c) hard-negative mining / anti-hub margin / proxy metric learning | **部分撞车，杀伤最大** | ReID hard mining/HAP2S/MS loss 主要按 anchor-local difficulty/相似度加权，不是全局误吸附 in-degree。**但 HAL 和 NeighborRetr 已经非常接近“训练端 hubness-aware loss + memory/global stats”**，只是任务是图文/跨模态检索，不是 person ReID。 | HAL 用 memory bank 和 kNN query 统计 hub，并在训练 loss 中加权；NeighborRetr 明确 bad/good hubs、centrality、memory bank、训练端缓解 hubness。链接：[HAL](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10097), [NeighborRetr](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10526), [HAP2S ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.11206), [MS Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.06627) | 9 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/video_feasibility.md:682:| (c) hard-negative mining / anti-hub margin / proxy metric learning | **部分撞车，杀伤最大** | ReID hard mining/HAP2S/MS loss 主要按 anchor-local difficulty/相似度加权，不是全局误吸附 in-degree。**但 HAL 和 NeighborRetr 已经非常接近“训练端 hubness-aware loss + memory/global stats”**，只是任务是图文/跨模态检索，不是 person ReID。 | HAL 用 memory bank 和 kNN query 统计 hub，并在训练 loss 中加权；NeighborRetr 明确 bad/good hubs、centrality、memory bank、训练端缓解 hubness。链接：[HAL](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10097), [NeighborRetr](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10526), [HAP2S ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.11206), [MS Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.06627) | 9 |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:213:2. **opposite-view retrieval loss**(`OVLIHead.loss`): batch 内, anchor(view v)的 positive = 同 pid 的 **opposite-view(1-v)** 样本, negative = 其它 pid 的 opposite-view 样本; **同视角样本完全排除出候选**(纯跨视角目标)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:215:   - 多正样本: **logsumexp supervised-contrastive**(`L_i = -logsumexp(score(i,pos)/τ) + logsumexp(score(i,cand)/τ)`, τ=0.05), 对"有 ≥1 opp 正 且 ≥1 opp 负"的 anchor 求均值。**无 memory/EMA/prototype。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:260:- **本地隔离 numeric smoke test(导入仓库真实 OVLIHead, 非副本)全过**: token shape (64,32,256) 逐 token L2-norm; sym_MaxSim 对称、self 对角≈1; 正常 batch loss 有限>0 且梯度回流 **proj.weight + global feat**; all-same-view batch loss=0 不崩; 某 pid 无 opp 正样本时该 anchor 被排除、loss 仍有限、grad 有限; fp16 cached map→fp32 token; AdamW 实际推动 proj 权重。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1815:../claude_review_ovli.md:65:### M5. CARGO PK 采样不保证每 batch 同 pid 跨双视角，OVLI 有效 anchor 比例可能偏低（数据动力学，非 bug）
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1816:../claude_review_ovli.md:67:- **事实**: 若某 pid 的 4 个采样实例恰好同视角(或对侧视角 pid 在 batch 内不足)，该 pid 的 anchor 进不了 `valid`。CARGO 训练集 aerial/ground 分布不均时，早期 epoch 有效 anchor 数可能波动。loss 仍正确(对 valid 求均值，无 valid 则 0)，但**有效监督密度**取决于数据。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:57:4. **SMPL/人体几何对 ReID 无超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特信号**（exp333/poseCLIP/SMPL-anchor/GOPL 四连证）——别再投。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:433:> 大家以为强 ReID 失败来自"某个 query 没匹配好"（pairwise 相似度病），其实是 **少数 gallery 样本变成很多 query 的吸附点**——错误是 **many-to-one 的图库拓扑病**。ReID 不是独立 query-gallery pair matching，而是 **directed kNN graph retrieval**；隐藏变量不是 hard-negative distance，而是 gallery 的 **负向 in-degree / hub mass**（≠hard negative：hard 是对一个 anchor 近；hub 是对**很多不同身份**都近，是全局误吸附点）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess.sh:12:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_ANALYSIS.md:8:强 ReID(Swin/SOLIDER, Market 94.6 / Occluded-Duke 73)仍有残差失败。大家默认失败来自"某个 query 没匹配好"(pairwise similarity 病)。**重定义: 强 ReID 的残差失败是 gallery topology 的 many-to-one 吸附——少数 gallery 图像成为很多不同身份 query 的误吸附点(negative in-degree hub)。** ReID 不是独立 pair matching, 是 directed kNN graph retrieval; 隐藏变量 = gallery 的负向 in-degree, 不是 hard-negative distance(hard 对一个 anchor 近; hub 对很多不同身份都近)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_ANALYSIS.md:43:- vs hard-negative mining: H_neg 是全局误吸附(对很多身份), 非 anchor-local difficulty。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2512:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:2942:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:3111:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_hubness.md:14:我们要做 ReID 方法 **Gallery Hubness ReID**。重定义: 强 ReID 失败不是 pairwise 相似度病, 而是**少数 gallery 样本变成很多不同身份 query 的吸附点**(负向 in-degree / hub mass)=many-to-one 图库拓扑病。机制: 训练端 anti-hub margin(对全局误吸附 gallery 降权), memory bank 存 cross-ID top-k in-degree, negative 权重从'离anchor近'改'是否全局误吸附点', 测试仍单 embedding(不变 test-time trick)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3733:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_14.md:68:结论先放前面：**CLIP/DINO/SAM 直接当 backbone、prompt learner、text anchor、SAM 遮挡增强、LVLM 生成语义 token 这条线基本红了**。2024-2026 已经有 CLIP 语义注入 VI-ReID、CLIP selective prompt tuning、LVLM-ReID、LLaVA/MLLM interactive ReID、SAM occlusion augmentation、KPR promptable ReID 等工作在占位。继续“导入 FM 提精度”不建议碰。参考：CSDN/CLIP-VIReID 已做语义桥接与 prompt learner([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.05806))，SCING 做 selective cross-modal prompt tuning([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00506))，LVLM-ReID 做 LVLM semantic token([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18111))，LLaVA-ReID/ICL 已做交互式文本 ReID([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.10174))，DPEFormer 已用 SAM 做 realistic occlusion augmentation([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435))。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/clean/r_2.txt:10:ReID 不是独立 query-gallery pair matching，而是 **directed kNN graph retrieval**。隐藏变量不是 hard negative distance，而是 gallery 的 **negative in-degree / hub mass**。这和普通 hard negative mining 不一样：hard negative 是“对一个 anchor 很近”，hub 是“对很多不同身份都很近”。旧 triplet/quadruplet 主要还是 per-anchor 或 batch 内 hard sample。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1704.01719))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/clean/r_2.txt:16:- 正常 ID loss / triplet 保留，但 negative 权重从“离 anchor 多近”改为“它是否是全局误吸附点”；

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1735:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:5053:- **Medium:** OVLI loss can silently have reduced effective signal because `RandomIdentitySampler` samples `K` images per PID but does not force opposite-view composition: [cargo_dataset.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/afd_reid/cargo_dataset.py:226). The loss correctly skips anchors without both opposite-view positive and negative candidates: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:316), but logs only loss/pos/neg/gap: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:677). Add `valid_anchor_frac`, `pos_per_valid`, `neg_per_valid` before long training so low OVLI loss is not confused with “no valid anchors.”

The loss correctly skips anchors without both opposite-view positive and negative candidates: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:316), but logs only loss/pos/neg/gap: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:677). Add `valid_anchor_frac`, `pos_per_valid`, `neg_per_valid` before long training so low OVLI loss is not confused with “no valid anchors.”

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/clean/r_1.txt:9:SMPL 更不用救。你们自己的结果已经形成稳定 meta-pattern：β≈random、pose+CLIP 死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈廉价代理。结论应写死：**SMPL/人体几何在你们现有 ReID 设置里没有超出遮挡数量和视角差的独特判别信号。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/gallery_growth_method_design.md:83:已经看完核心文献脉络：2024 的 backward-compatible LReID 明确把“gallery 也累积”拉进问题定义，但目标是免 backfilling / feature compatibility；2024-2026 的 LReID 新方法仍主要在抗遗忘、adapter、distillation、semantic anchor 上发力。我还没看到把旧域掉点拆成“模型遗忘 vs frozen 表示下 gallery 膨胀税”的明确控制实验。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:2388:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3292:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:18:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3617:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:3023:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_debate.sh:10:**Gallery Hubness re-frame**: 强 ReID 失败不是 pairwise 相似度病, 而是少数 gallery 样本成为很多不同身份 query 的误吸附点(gallery 负向 in-degree / hub mass)=many-to-one 图库拓扑病。机制设想: 训练端 anti-hub embedding(memory bank 存 cross-ID in-degree, anti-hub margin, 负样本权重从'离anchor近'改'是否全局误吸附点', 测试仍单 embedding 不 re-rank)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3650:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4138:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2001:./ondisk_pivot.md:380:| (c) hard-negative mining / anti-hub margin / proxy metric learning | **部分撞车，杀伤最大** | ReID hard mining/HAP2S/MS loss 主要按 anchor-local difficulty/相似度加权，不是全局误吸附 in-degree。**但 HAL 和 NeighborRetr 已经非常接近“训练端 hubness-aware loss + memory/global stats”**，只是任务是图文/跨模态检索，不是 person ReID。 | HAL 用 memory bank 和 kNN query 统计 hub，并在训练 loss 中加权；NeighborRetr 明确 bad/good hubs、centrality、memory bank、训练端缓解 hubness。链接：[HAL](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10097), [NeighborRetr](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10526), [HAP2S ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.11206), [MS Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.06627) | 9 |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3723:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:4240:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4500:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4893:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3102:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4153:reassess/r_2.md:993:reassess/r_3.md:1951:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess.sh:12:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6159:Strong supervised ReID is often treated as "solved" on Market (94+ mAP). Yet a residual of queries fail even with state-of-the-art backbones. The dominant framing treats each failure as an isolated **pairwise** problem—this query's feature is not close enough to its gallery match. We argue the residual failure is better understood as a **directed kNN-graph** property of the gallery: **a few gallery images become attraction hubs for many queries of unrelated identities** (many-to-one). The hidden variable is the gallery's **negative in-degree**, distinct from hard-negative distance (hard = close to *one* anchor; hub = close to *many different identities*).
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6214:强 ReID(Swin/SOLIDER, Market 94.6 / Occluded-Duke 73)仍有残差失败。大家默认失败来自"某个 query 没匹配好"(pairwise similarity 病)。**重定义: 强 ReID 的残差失败是 gallery topology 的 many-to-one 吸附——少数 gallery 图像成为很多不同身份 query 的误吸附点(negative in-degree hub)。** ReID 不是独立 pair matching, 是 directed kNN graph retrieval; 隐藏变量 = gallery 的负向 in-degree, 不是 hard-negative distance(hard 对一个 anchor 近; hub 对很多不同身份都近)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6249:- vs hard-negative mining: H_neg 是全局误吸附(对很多身份), 非 anchor-local difficulty。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1569:reassess/r_3.md:3429:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2805:区别：最像 OCCNet 和 PSCR，但它们在二维 token、姿态热图或跨模态补全里做文章；我们把航拍和地面的差异定义为三维身体表面可见性不一致，用 SMPL mesh 或 joints 建立 canonical body surface，再做可见表面对齐和缺失表面补全。这个切开点比“加姿态注意力”强。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1926:reassess/r_3.md:4499:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:141:"mechanism": "Per frame, an off-the-shelf 3D human reconstruction (HMR/SMPL) produces a pedestrian mesh, which is converted to a point cloud and back-projected with image RGB; a detection-free PointPillar backbone encodes it into a pseudo-image (\"pillar-based feature\") whose dimensions are aligned with 2D ResNet image features. A Cross-Modal Fusion (CMF) module uses deformable cross-attention where pillar features are queries and 2D-to-3D mapping gives reference points, so sampling locations on the image are anchored at projected pedestrian body positions. A separate Shape-aware Spatial-Temporal Interaction (SSTI) module runs parallel spatial/temporal self-attention over SMPL shape parameters (β) to form a video-level 3D-shape descriptor; CMF fusion features (after temporal aggregation) and the SSTI shape feature are concatenated as the final representation, trained with cross-entropy + triplet.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1927:reassess/r_3.md:4500:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1944:reassess/r_3.md:4544:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/results.md:1667:- **结论**：机制**有明确相对信号**，pose-anchored DINO correspondence 在重遮挡上 3-4 倍超整图基准且 pose 锚定占绝对主导 → kill-switch 命中正向条件，**值得 exp324b 上轻量 part-projection 头 / LoRA**。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:6449:ReID 不是独立 query-gallery pair matching，而是 **directed kNN graph retrieval**。隐藏变量不是 hard negative distance，而是 gallery 的 **negative in-degree / hub mass**。这和普通 hard negative mining 不一样：hard negative 是“对一个 anchor 很近”，hub 是“对很多不同身份都很近”。旧 triplet/quadruplet 主要还是 per-anchor 或 batch 内 hard sample。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1704.01719))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:6455:- 正常 ID loss / triplet 保留，但 negative 权重从“离 anchor 多近”改为“它是否是全局误吸附点”；
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:6510:ReID 不是独立 query-gallery pair matching，而是 **directed kNN graph retrieval**。隐藏变量不是 hard negative distance，而是 gallery 的 **negative in-degree / hub mass**。这和普通 hard negative mining 不一样：hard negative 是“对一个 anchor 很近”，hub 是“对很多不同身份都很近”。旧 triplet/quadruplet 主要还是 per-anchor 或 batch 内 hard sample。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1704.01719))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:6516:- 正常 ID loss / triplet 保留，但 negative 权重从“离 anchor 多近”改为“它是否是全局误吸附点”；
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:42:Strong supervised ReID is often treated as "solved" on Market (94+ mAP). Yet a residual of queries fail even with state-of-the-art backbones. The dominant framing treats each failure as an isolated **pairwise** problem—this query's feature is not close enough to its gallery match. We argue the residual failure is better understood as a **directed kNN-graph** property of the gallery: **a few gallery images become attraction hubs for many queries of unrelated identities** (many-to-one). The hidden variable is the gallery's **negative in-degree**, distinct from hard-negative distance (hard = close to *one* anchor; hub = close to *many different identities*).
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:97:强 ReID(Swin/SOLIDER, Market 94.6 / Occluded-Duke 73)仍有残差失败。大家默认失败来自"某个 query 没匹配好"(pairwise similarity 病)。**重定义: 强 ReID 的残差失败是 gallery topology 的 many-to-one 吸附——少数 gallery 图像成为很多不同身份 query 的误吸附点(negative in-degree hub)。** ReID 不是独立 pair matching, 是 directed kNN graph retrieval; 隐藏变量 = gallery 的负向 in-degree, 不是 hard-negative distance(hard 对一个 anchor 近; hub 对很多不同身份都近)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:132:- vs hard-negative mining: H_neg 是全局误吸附(对很多身份), 非 anchor-local difficulty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/debate/d_2.md:16:**Gallery Hubness re-frame**: 强 ReID 失败不是 pairwise 相似度病, 而是少数 gallery 样本成为很多不同身份 query 的误吸附点(gallery 负向 in-degree / hub mass)=many-to-one 图库拓扑病。机制设想: 训练端 anti-hub embedding(memory bank 存 cross-ID in-degree, anti-hub margin, 负样本权重从'离anchor近'改'是否全局误吸附点', 测试仍单 embedding 不 re-rank)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1857:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_14.txt:1:结论先放前面：**CLIP/DINO/SAM 直接当 backbone、prompt learner、text anchor、SAM 遮挡增强、LVLM 生成语义 token 这条线基本红了**。2024-2026 已经有 CLIP 语义注入 VI-ReID、CLIP selective prompt tuning、LVLM-ReID、LLaVA/MLLM interactive ReID、SAM occlusion augmentation、KPR promptable ReID 等工作在占位。继续“导入 FM 提精度”不建议碰。参考：CSDN/CLIP-VIReID 已做语义桥接与 prompt learner([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.05806))，SCING 做 selective cross-modal prompt tuning([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00506))，LVLM-ReID 做 LVLM semantic token([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18111))，LLaVA-ReID/ICL 已做交互式文本 ReID([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.10174))，DPEFormer 已用 SAM 做 realistic occlusion augmentation([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435))。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/evidence_method_design.md:428:- **本地隔离 numeric smoke test(导入仓库真实 OVLIHead, 非副本)全过**: token shape (64,32,256) 逐 token L2-norm; sym_MaxSim 对称、self 对角≈1; 正常 batch loss 有限>0 且梯度回流 **proj.weight + global feat**; all-same-view batch loss=0 不崩; 某 pid 无 opp 正样本时该 anchor 被排除、loss 仍有限、grad 有限; fp16 cached map→fp32 token; AdamW 实际推动 proj 权重。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_debate.sh:10:**Gallery Hubness re-frame**: 强 ReID 失败不是 pairwise 相似度病, 而是少数 gallery 样本成为很多不同身份 query 的误吸附点(gallery 负向 in-degree / hub mass)=many-to-one 图库拓扑病。机制设想: 训练端 anti-hub embedding(memory bank 存 cross-ID in-degree, anti-hub margin, 负样本权重从'离anchor近'改'是否全局误吸附点', 测试仍单 embedding 不 re-rank)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:18:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4499:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:141:"mechanism": "Per frame, an off-the-shelf 3D human reconstruction (HMR/SMPL) produces a pedestrian mesh, which is converted to a point cloud and back-projected with image RGB; a detection-free PointPillar backbone encodes it into a pseudo-image (\"pillar-based feature\") whose dimensions are aligned with 2D ResNet image features. A Cross-Modal Fusion (CMF) module uses deformable cross-attention where pillar features are queries and 2D-to-3D mapping gives reference points, so sampling locations on the image are anchored at projected pedestrian body positions. A separate Shape-aware Spatial-Temporal Interaction (SSTI) module runs parallel spatial/temporal self-attention over SMPL shape parameters (β) to form a video-level 3D-shape descriptor; CMF fusion features (after temporal aggregation) and the SSTI shape feature are concatenated as the final representation, trained with cross-entropy + triplet.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4500:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4807:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/fm_occluded_reid_study.md:15:DINOv2 pose-anchored part-MaxSim vs Swin MaxSim，重遮挡 oracle 检查：top-10 Jaccard 0.062，**P_dino_only 0.20%**(989 query 里只 2 个 DINO 命中而 Swin 漏)，**oracle 上界仅 +0.12 mAP**。低 Jaccard 是"假正交"——DINO 不是补充，是全局太弱(8.65 vs 72.57)。Swin 错的地方 DINO 也错。→ DINO⊕Swin 融合/re-rank 家族全死（两 agent 独立确认）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:6128:./reassess.sh:12:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8010:./reassess/r_3.md:4500:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8680:2. **重定义动作**：作者把问题讲成“跨模态对齐缺少显式、模态无关的 semantic anchor”，而不是“再做一个 CLIP prompt”。关键词是 attribute-aware text、contour-aware text prompt、text re-definition、category-level textual prototypes、modality-agnostic semantic anchors。这个重定义把文本从辅助描述变成“RGB 和 IR 共同对齐的类别原型”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8733:analyses/deep_15.txt:21:4. **证据闭环**：最关键的是 hard triple 可视化：anchor 和 positive 衣服完全不同，negative 衣服相似。baseline 会被衣服纹理吸走，认为 negative 更像；IFD 则更关注头部和人体轮廓。消融里 IKT、CBD 单独有效，二者合用更强；clothing contrastive loss 明显优于普通 supervised contrastive loss，这正好证明“衣服区域要解耦而不是简单忽略”。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:954:experiments/exp322/design.md:26:- **数据流**：anchor crop x（目标 pid=y）→ 从同 batch 不同 ID y'≠y 抠 pose-masked 人体块 → pose-aware 贴到目标人体边缘（制造 **overlap** 非 covering）得污染图 x̃ → 生成 multi-person heatmap（person-0=y, person-1=y'）+ 记录 distractor 真实 pid y' → backbone（可选 attribution gate）→ (a) **不变性锚**：f(x̃) global+part 经 CE/triplet 监督到 y；(b) **反事实对比锚**：triplet(anchor=f(x̃)目标, positive=同 y 另一图, negative=x̃ 内部 distractor pooled 表征)；(c) **exact dedup**（已知 pid + bbox IoU 跳过重叠/同人样本）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:995:./experiments/exp322/design.md:26:- **数据流**：anchor crop x（目标 pid=y）→ 从同 batch 不同 ID y'≠y 抠 pose-masked 人体块 → pose-aware 贴到目标人体边缘（制造 **overlap** 非 covering）得污染图 x̃ → 生成 multi-person heatmap（person-0=y, person-1=y'）+ 记录 distractor 真实 pid y' → backbone（可选 attribution gate）→ (a) **不变性锚**：f(x̃) global+part 经 CE/triplet 监督到 y；(b) **反事实对比锚**：triplet(anchor=f(x̃)目标, positive=同 y 另一图, negative=x̃ 内部 distractor pooled 表征)；(c) **exact dedup**（已知 pid + bbox IoU 跳过重叠/同人样本）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2833:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_14.txt:1:结论先放前面：**CLIP/DINO/SAM 直接当 backbone、prompt learner、text anchor、SAM 遮挡增强、LVLM 生成语义 token 这条线基本红了**。2024-2026 已经有 CLIP 语义注入 VI-ReID、CLIP selective prompt tuning、LVLM-ReID、LLaVA/MLLM interactive ReID、SAM occlusion augmentation、KPR promptable ReID 等工作在占位。继续“导入 FM 提精度”不建议碰。参考：CSDN/CLIP-VIReID 已做语义桥接与 prompt learner([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.05806))，SCING 做 selective cross-modal prompt tuning([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00506))，LVLM-ReID 做 LVLM semantic token([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18111))，LLaVA-ReID/ICL 已做交互式文本 ReID([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.10174))，DPEFormer 已用 SAM 做 realistic occlusion augmentation([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435))。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3044:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4406:./reassess/r_3.md:4500:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3045:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4408:./reassess/r_3.md:4544:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/results.md:1667:- **结论**：机制**有明确相对信号**，pose-anchored DINO correspondence 在重遮挡上 3-4 倍超整图基准且 pose 锚定占绝对主导 → kill-switch 命中正向条件，**值得 exp324b 上轻量 part-projection 头 / LoRA**。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3476:experiments/exp322/design.md:26:- **数据流**：anchor crop x（目标 pid=y）→ 从同 batch 不同 ID y'≠y 抠 pose-masked 人体块 → pose-aware 贴到目标人体边缘（制造 **overlap** 非 covering）得污染图 x̃ → 生成 multi-person heatmap（person-0=y, person-1=y'）+ 记录 distractor 真实 pid y' → backbone（可选 attribution gate）→ (a) **不变性锚**：f(x̃) global+part 经 CE/triplet 监督到 y；(b) **反事实对比锚**：triplet(anchor=f(x̃)目标, positive=同 y 另一图, negative=x̃ 内部 distractor pooled 表征)；(c) **exact dedup**（已知 pid + bbox IoU 跳过重叠/同人样本）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3686:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:141:"mechanism": "Per frame, an off-the-shelf 3D human reconstruction (HMR/SMPL) produces a pedestrian mesh, which is converted to a point cloud and back-projected with image RGB; a detection-free PointPillar backbone encodes it into a pseudo-image (\"pillar-based feature\") whose dimensions are aligned with 2D ResNet image features. A Cross-Modal Fusion (CMF) module uses deformable cross-attention where pillar features are queries and 2D-to-3D mapping gives reference points, so sampling locations on the image are anchored at projected pedestrian body positions. A separate Shape-aware Spatial-Temporal Interaction (SSTI) module runs parallel spatial/temporal self-attention over SMPL shape parameters (β) to form a video-level 3D-shape descriptor; CMF fusion features (after temporal aggregation) and the SSTI shape feature are concatenated as the final representation, trained with cross-entropy + triplet.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3687:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3688:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:143:"novel_component": "Deformable cross-attention where the reference points are not learned but supplied by a 2D-to-3D mapping from an off-the-shelf body reconstruction (φ: mesh point -> image location), so attention sampling is grounded on projected body geometry. The 3D mesh thus acts as a structural anchor that exists even where 2D pixels are unreliable.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:4028:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_14.md:68:结论先放前面：**CLIP/DINO/SAM 直接当 backbone、prompt learner、text anchor、SAM 遮挡增强、LVLM 生成语义 token 这条线基本红了**。2024-2026 已经有 CLIP 语义注入 VI-ReID、CLIP selective prompt tuning、LVLM-ReID、LLaVA/MLLM interactive ReID、SAM occlusion augmentation、KPR promptable ReID 等工作在占位。继续“导入 FM 提精度”不建议碰。参考：CSDN/CLIP-VIReID 已做语义桥接与 prompt learner([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.05806))，SCING 做 selective cross-modal prompt tuning([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00506))，LVLM-ReID 做 LVLM semantic token([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18111))，LLaVA-ReID/ICL 已做交互式文本 ReID([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.10174))，DPEFormer 已用 SAM 做 realistic occlusion augmentation([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435))。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:4239:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4499:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:141:"mechanism": "Per frame, an off-the-shelf 3D human reconstruction (HMR/SMPL) produces a pedestrian mesh, which is converted to a point cloud and back-projected with image RGB; a detection-free PointPillar backbone encodes it into a pseudo-image (\"pillar-based feature\") whose dimensions are aligned with 2D ResNet image features. A Cross-Modal Fusion (CMF) module uses deformable cross-attention where pillar features are queries and 2D-to-3D mapping gives reference points, so sampling locations on the image are anchored at projected pedestrian body positions. A separate Shape-aware Spatial-Temporal Interaction (SSTI) module runs parallel spatial/temporal self-attention over SMPL shape parameters (β) to form a video-level 3D-shape descriptor; CMF fusion features (after temporal aggregation) and the SSTI shape feature are concatenated as the final representation, trained with cross-entropy + triplet.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:4240:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4500:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/deep_25.txt:43:2. **重定义动作**：作者把问题讲成“跨模态对齐缺少显式、模态无关的 semantic anchor”，而不是“再做一个 CLIP prompt”。关键词是 attribute-aware text、contour-aware text prompt、text re-definition、category-level textual prototypes、modality-agnostic semantic anchors。这个重定义把文本从辅助描述变成“RGB 和 IR 共同对齐的类别原型”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:406:4. **证据闭环**：最关键的是 hard triple 可视化：anchor 和 positive 衣服完全不同，negative 衣服相似。baseline 会被衣服纹理吸走，认为 negative 更像；IFD 则更关注头部和人体轮廓。消融里 IKT、CBD 单独有效，二者合用更强；clothing contrastive loss 明显优于普通 supervised contrastive loss，这正好证明“衣服区域要解耦而不是简单忽略”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:701:2. **重定义动作**：大家以为问题主要是“文本和图像对齐不够好”，作者改写成“实例级文本匹配不符合身份级检索目标”。关键词是 identity-level structure、Query-Prototype Similarity、image-side identity anchors、training-free refinement。它不是说再训一个更强对齐模型，而是说图库本身已经有身份结构，应该在推理时被用作先验。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_hubness.md:14:我们要做 ReID 方法 **Gallery Hubness ReID**。重定义: 强 ReID 失败不是 pairwise 相似度病, 而是**少数 gallery 样本变成很多不同身份 query 的吸附点**(负向 in-degree / hub mass)=many-to-one 图库拓扑病。机制: 训练端 anti-hub margin(对全局误吸附 gallery 降权), memory bank 存 cross-ID top-k in-degree, negative 权重从'离anchor近'改'是否全局误吸附点', 测试仍单 embedding(不变 test-time trick)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_hubness.md:36:web search: Proxy-NCA metric learning proxy anchor loss hard negative mining hubness
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_hubness.md:101:| (c) hard-negative mining / anti-hub margin / proxy metric learning | **部分撞车，杀伤最大** | ReID hard mining/HAP2S/MS loss 主要按 anchor-local difficulty/相似度加权，不是全局误吸附 in-degree。**但 HAL 和 NeighborRetr 已经非常接近“训练端 hubness-aware loss + memory/global stats”**，只是任务是图文/跨模态检索，不是 person ReID。 | HAL 用 memory bank 和 kNN query 统计 hub，并在训练 loss 中加权；NeighborRetr 明确 bad/good hubs、centrality、memory bank、训练端缓解 hubness。链接：[HAL](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10097), [NeighborRetr](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10526), [HAP2S ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.11206), [MS Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.06627) | 9 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_hubness.md:121:| (c) hard-negative mining / anti-hub margin / proxy metric learning | **部分撞车，杀伤最大** | ReID hard mining/HAP2S/MS loss 主要按 anchor-local difficulty/相似度加权，不是全局误吸附 in-degree。**但 HAL 和 NeighborRetr 已经非常接近“训练端 hubness-aware loss + memory/global stats”**，只是任务是图文/跨模态检索，不是 person ReID。 | HAL 用 memory bank 和 kNN query 统计 hub，并在训练 loss 中加权；NeighborRetr 明确 bad/good hubs、centrality、memory bank、训练端缓解 hubness。链接：[HAL](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10097), [NeighborRetr](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10526), [HAP2S ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.11206), [MS Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.06627) | 9 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:9:Strong supervised ReID is often treated as "solved" on Market (94+ mAP). Yet a residual of queries fail even with state-of-the-art backbones. The dominant framing treats each failure as an isolated **pairwise** problem—this query's feature is not close enough to its gallery match. We argue the residual failure is better understood as a **directed kNN-graph** property of the gallery: **a few gallery images become attraction hubs for many queries of unrelated identities** (many-to-one). The hidden variable is the gallery's **negative in-degree**, distinct from hard-negative distance (hard = close to *one* anchor; hub = close to *many different identities*).

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:2116:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:1:# 实验 SMPL-Anchor VI-ReID (v0 preliminary) — SMPL 几何当模态无关锚
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:2117:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:6:- VI-ReID(可见光-红外行人ReID)核心 confound = **模态 gap**: RGB 有颜色/纹理, IR 有热强度, 外观差异巨大。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:2118:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:9:- ★空白: 文献里没人用 **SMPL 3D 几何**当 VI-ReID 模态锚(轮廓/体形有人做, 3D mesh 几何是空白)。团队有 SMPL 基建(ROMP/SMPLer-X)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:2119:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:13:SMPL 3D 几何当**训练期特权(LUPI)模态共享锚**, 把同人的 RGB/IR 特征拉到同一几何上 → 缩小模态 gap → VI-ReID 涨点; 且增益来自几何对齐(非通用正则, 由 shuffle 对照证伪)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:2120:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/design.md:35:→ **转 fallback: Swin-VI 机制**。VI-ReID 至今 ResNet50 主导、无 Swin/CLIP 赢家(纯 ViT PMT 才 67.5 R1), 团队是 Swin/SOLIDER 专家。CAJ ResNet baseline 已搭好(POOL 76.80/69.14)→ 换 Swin-Small(SOLIDER pretrain)→ 强 backbone 在 VI-ReID 帮不帮? 帮=机制论文; 不帮=为什么不帮(模态 gap 吞掉 backbone 红利)也是机制问题。先做这个经验首验。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:2224:experiments/smpl_anchor_vireid/baseline_integration_plan.md:13:- RegDBData 读 idx/train_visible_{trial}.txt(每行 path label)→ PIL load → resize(144,288)。**坑: __init__ 硬编码覆盖 data_dir='../Datasets/...'(改路径改这);Image.ANTIALIAS Pillow≥10 已删, 换 LANCZOS**。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:2230:experiments/exp327_dinov3/design.md:10:- DINOv3（2025）与 DINOv2-with-registers 都改进了 dense feature 质量：registers 去掉了 ViT 的 high-norm artifact token（更干净的 patch 特征），DINOv3 用更大数据 + Gram anchoring 进一步提纯 dense 特征。**若更干净的 dense 对应能直接抬训练-free 重遮挡 mAP，则更强冻结源的天花板更高，值得优先上头。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:3336:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3993:experiments/fm_occluded_reid_study.md:15:DINOv2 pose-anchored part-MaxSim vs Swin MaxSim，重遮挡 oracle 检查：top-10 Jaccard 0.062，**P_dino_only 0.20%**(989 query 里只 2 个 DINO 命中而 Swin 漏)，**oracle 上界仅 +0.12 mAP**。低 Jaccard 是"假正交"——DINO 不是补充，是全局太弱(8.65 vs 72.57)。Swin 错的地方 DINO 也错。→ DINO⊕Swin 融合/re-rank 家族全死（两 agent 独立确认）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:4110:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:293:我们要做 ReID 方法 **Gallery Hubness ReID**。重定义: 强 ReID 失败不是 pairwise 相似度病, 而是**少数 gallery 样本变成很多不同身份 query 的吸附点**(负向 in-degree / hub mass)=many-to-one 图库拓扑病。机制: 训练端 anti-hub margin(对全局误吸附 gallery 降权), memory bank 存 cross-ID top-k in-degree, negative 权重从'离anchor近'改'是否全局误吸附点', 测试仍单 embedding(不变 test-time trick)。

The loss correctly skips anchors without both opposite-view positive and negative candidates: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:316), but logs only loss/pos/neg/gap: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:677). Add `valid_anchor_frac`, `pos_per_valid`, `neg_per_valid` before long training so low OVLI loss is not confused with “no valid anchors.”

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_16.md:88:触发观察：Fed-Protoid 这类方法会用 source prototypes 做分布对齐，很多 FedDG 也会交换 feature statistics/style/semantic anchors。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.12589)) 但 ReID 的 prototype/feature 本身接近 biometric template；已有旧工作证明 deep ReID features 可泄露属性和重建信息，并建议加密特征。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2108.07147)) 2024-26 新 FedReID 论文大多把“不传图像”当隐私前提，没有系统报告通信消息是否可被 re-identify。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20391:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4467:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1548:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:5053:- **Medium:** OVLI loss can silently have reduced effective signal because `RandomIdentitySampler` samples `K` images per PID but does not force opposite-view composition: [cargo_dataset.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/afd_reid/cargo_dataset.py:226). The loss correctly skips anchors without both opposite-view positive and negative candidates: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:316), but logs only loss/pos/neg/gap: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:677). experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_14.md:68:结论先放前面：**CLIP/DINO/SAM 直接当 backbone、prompt learner、text anchor、SAM 遮挡增强、LVLM 生成语义 token 这条线基本红了**。2024-2026 已经有 CLIP 语义注入 VI-ReID、CLIP selective prompt tuning、LVLM-ReID、LLaVA/MLLM interactive ReID、SAM occlusion augmentation、KPR promptable ReID 等工作在占位。继续“导入 FM 提精度”不建议碰。参考：CSDN/CLIP-VIReID 已做语义桥接与 prompt learner([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.05806))，SCING 做 selective cross-modal prompt tuning([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00506))，LVLM-ReID 做 LVLM semantic token([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18111))，LLaVA-ReID/ICL 已做交互式文本 ReID([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.10174))，DPEFormer 已用 SAM 做 realistic occlusion augmentation([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435))。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_16.txt:29:触发观察：Fed-Protoid 这类方法会用 source prototypes 做分布对齐，很多 FedDG 也会交换 feature statistics/style/semantic anchors。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.12589)) 但 ReID 的 prototype/feature 本身接近 biometric template；已有旧工作证明 deep ReID features 可泄露属性和重建信息，并建议加密特征。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2108.07147)) 2024-26 新 FedReID 论文大多把“不传图像”当隐私前提，没有系统报告通信消息是否可被 re-identify。

     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""exp361 PSC-JEPA continued-pretrain — Stage-A skeleton (same-image EMA teacher, no support bank yet).
     3	
     4	Idea: continued-pretrain SOLIDER swin_tiny so the backbone learns "how to form retrievable identity
     5	evidence when a body part is missing". JEPA in LATENT body-part-token space (not pixel):
     6	  teacher (EMA, sees FULL image) -> part tokens T[B,G,C]
     7	  student (sees pose-defined PARTIAL view, some body groups masked) -> part tokens S[B,G,C]
     8	  L_part_jepa: student must PREDICT the dropped-group teacher tokens from the visible context.
     9	  L_visible_anchor: visible-group student tokens stay close to teacher (don't drift).
    10	  L_union: pooled identity token (student) close to teacher full identity token.
    11	
    12	Stage-A intentionally uses ONLY same-image EMA teacher (= codex's 3090 control "is it just OA-SD/PCVT
    13	renamed"). The MAIN novelty (pseudo same-ID support bank T_bank) is Stage-B, added on top once this
    14	skeleton trains stably. Coordinate-system / loss-collapse points are flagged @REVIEW for codex审 diff.
    15	
    16	Run: python psc_jepa_pretrain.py --backbone pretrained/swin_tiny.pth --data data/occluded_duke \

    44	DEV = 'cuda'
    45	IMG_H, IMG_W = 384, 128

    47	
    48	# --- COCO-17 keypoints -> 5 body groups (indices) ---
    49	# 0 nose,1-2 eyes,3-4 ears,5-6 shoulders,7-8 elbows,9-10 wrists,11-12 hips,13-14 knees,15-16 ankles
    50	GROUPS = {
    51	    'head':  [0, 1, 2, 3, 4],

    60	def load_pose(npz):
    61	    d = np.load(os.path.join(cli.repo, npz), allow_pickle=True)
    62	    fn = d['filenames']; vis = d['visibility'].astype(np.float32); kp = d['keypoints'].astype(np.float32)
    63	    return {fn[i]: (kp[i], vis[i]) for i in range(len(fn))}                  # name -> (kp[17,2], vis[17])

    65	
    66	class PSCDataset(torch.utils.data.Dataset):
    67	    """image (384x128 tensor) + per-group visibility mask + per-group featmap-grid region mask."""
    68	    def __init__(self, data, pose):
    69	        self.dir = os.path.join(cli.repo, data, 'bounding_box_train')
    70	        self.pose = load_pose(pose)
    71	        self.items = [f for f in sorted(os.listdir(self.dir)) if f.endswith('.jpg') and f in self.pose]
    72	        if cli.smoke:
    73	            self.items = self.items[:cli.smoke]
    74	        self.mean = torch.tensor([0.485, 0.456, 0.406]).view(3, 1, 1)
    75	        self.std = torch.tensor([0.229, 0.224, 0.225]).view(3, 1, 1)
    76	
    77	    def __len__(self):
    78	        return len(self.items)
    79	
    80	    def _grid_region(self, kp, vis):
    81	        """Per-group: visibility (any kp in group visible) + bbox region mask on GHxGW grid.
    82	        @REVIEW codex: keypoints are pixel coords in the ORIGINAL crop; we read crop size and normalize
    83	        to [0,1] then to grid. If pose npz coords are already resized to 384x128, drop the /w,/h."""
    84	        gvis = np.zeros(G, np.float32); gmask = np.zeros((G, GH, GW), np.float32)
    85	        for gi, gk in enumerate(GKEYS):
    86	            idx = GROUPS[gk]
    87	            v = vis[idx]; pts = kp[idx][v >= cli.vis_thr]
    88	            if len(pts) == 0:
    89	                continue
    90	            gvis[gi] = 1.0
    91	            xs = np.clip((pts[:, 0]) * GW, 0, GW - 1e-3); ys = np.clip((pts[:, 1]) * GH, 0, GH - 1e-3)
    92	            x0, x1 = int(xs.min()), int(xs.max()); y0, y1 = int(ys.min()), int(ys.max())
    93	            gmask[gi, y0:y1 + 1, x0:x1 + 1] = 1.0
    94	        return gvis, gmask
    95	
    96	    def __getitem__(self, i):
    97	        name = self.items[i]
    98	        im = Image.open(os.path.join(self.dir, name)).convert('RGB')
    99	        ow, oh = im.size
   100	        im = im.resize((IMG_W, IMG_H))
   101	        t = torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(im, np.float32).transpose(2, 0, 1) / 255.0)
   102	        t = (t - self.mean) / self.std
   103	        kp, vis = self.pose[name]
   104	        kpn = kp.copy(); kpn[:, 0] /= max(ow, 1); kpn[:, 1] /= max(oh, 1)    # normalize to [0,1]
   105	        gvis, gmask = self._grid_region(kpn, vis)
   106	        return t, torch.from_numpy(gvis), torch.from_numpy(gmask)

   109	def build_backbone(path=None):
   110	    path = path or cli.backbone
   111	    from model.backbones.swin_transformer import swin_tiny_patch4_window7_224
   112	    net = swin_tiny_patch4_window7_224(img_size=[IMG_H, IMG_W], drop_path_rate=0.1, drop_rate=0.0,
   113	                                       attn_drop_rate=0.0, pretrained=os.path.join(cli.repo, path),
   114	                                       convert_weights=False, semantic_weight=cli.semantic_weight)  # H2: match downstream 0.2
   115	    net.init_weights(os.path.join(cli.repo, path))
   116	    return net
   117	
   118	
   119	def part_pool(featmaps, gmask):
   120	    """featmaps[B,C,Hf,Wf] + gmask[B,G,Hf,Wf] -> part tokens[B,G,C] (masked avg-pool, L2)."""
   121	    B, C, Hf, Wf = featmaps.shape
   122	    if (Hf, Wf) != (GH, GW):
   123	        gmask = F.interpolate(gmask, size=(Hf, Wf), mode='nearest')
   124	    denom = gmask.sum((2, 3)).clamp_min(1.0)                                 # [B,G]
   125	    tok = torch.einsum('bchw,bghw->bgc', featmaps, gmask) / denom.unsqueeze(-1)
   126	    return F.normalize(tok, dim=2)
   127	
   128	
   129	def fwd_tokens(net, x, gmask):
   130	    out = net(x)
   131	    featmaps = out[1] if isinstance(out, (tuple, list)) else out
   132	    if isinstance(featmaps, (tuple, list)):
   133	        featmaps = featmaps[-1]
   134	    return part_pool(featmaps, gmask)                                        # [B,G,C]
   135	
   136	
   137	def main():
   138	    ds = PSCDataset(cli.data, cli.pose)
   139	    bs = min(cli.bs, len(ds)) if cli.smoke else cli.bs                      # v2-Med: smoke<bs 不静默空跑
   140	    dl = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(ds, batch_size=bs, shuffle=True, num_workers=8, drop_last=(not cli.smoke))
   141	    print(f"[PSC-JEPA] {len(ds)} train imgs, {len(dl)} iters/ep, G={G} groups", flush=True)
   142	    student = build_backbone().to(DEV); student.train()                    # SOLIDER swin .train()/.eval() 不返回 self, 不能链式调用
   143	    teacher = build_backbone().to(DEV); teacher.eval()
   144	    for p in teacher.parameters():
   145	        p.requires_grad_(False)
   146	    teacher.load_state_dict(student.state_dict())
   147	    anchor = None                                                          # Stage-B 防遗忘: frozen SOLIDER anchor (原始 swin_tiny, 不更新)
   148	    if cli.w_solider_anchor > 0:
   149	        anchor = build_backbone(cli.anchor_path).to(DEV); anchor.eval()
   150	        for p in anchor.parameters():
   151	            p.requires_grad_(False)
   152	    C = student.num_features[-1]                                            # C1: asymmetric predictor (BYOL/data2vec anti-collapse)
   153	    predictor = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(C, C), nn.BatchNorm1d(C), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(C, C)).to(DEV)
   154	    opt = torch.optim.AdamW(list(student.parameters()) + list(predictor.parameters()), lr=cli.lr, weight_decay=0.05)
   155	    os.makedirs(os.path.join(cli.repo, cli.out), exist_ok=True)
   156	    for ep in range(cli.epochs):
   157	        last = {}
   158	        for it, (x, gvis, gmask) in enumerate(dl):
   159	            x, gvis, gmask = x.to(DEV), gvis.to(DEV), gmask.to(DEV)          # [B,3,H,W],[B,G],[B,G,GH,GW]
   160	            B = x.shape[0]
   161	            if B < 2:                                                       # Low: predictor BatchNorm1d needs B>=2 (smoke 尾批保护)
   162	                continue
   163	            # teacher sees FULL image
   164	            with torch.no_grad():
   165	                T = fwd_tokens(teacher, x, gmask)                            # [B,G,C]
   166	            # student sees PARTIAL: drop `drop_groups` visible groups by masking image region
   167	            drop = torch.zeros(B, G, device=DEV)
   168	            for b in range(B):
   169	                vis_g = torch.where(gvis[b] > 0)[0]
   170	                nd = min(cli.drop_groups, max(0, len(vis_g) - 1))           # M1: keep >=1 visible, 不排除重遮挡样本(目标人群)
   171	                if nd > 0:

   175	            dmask_grid = (gmask * drop.unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1)).sum(1).clamp(0, 1)   # [B,GH,GW]
   176	            dmask_img = F.interpolate(dmask_grid.unsqueeze(1), size=(IMG_H, IMG_W), mode='nearest')
   177	            x_part = x * (1.0 - dmask_img)                                   # zero-out dropped region (post-norm≈mean, ok as occlusion)
   178	            S = fwd_tokens(student, x_part, gmask)                           # [B,G,C]
   179	            Sp = F.normalize(predictor(S.reshape(-1, C)).reshape(B, G, C), dim=2)  # C1: predictor(student) predicts teacher
   180	            # losses (cosine in latent token space, predictor-asymmetric)
   181	            cos = (Sp * T).sum(2)                                          # [B,G] predicted-vs-teacher sim
   182	            drop_m = drop * gvis                                           # only dropped & originally-visible
   183	            vis_m = (1.0 - drop) * gvis                                     # visible & kept
   184	            L_jepa = ((1.0 - cos) * drop_m).sum() / drop_m.sum().clamp_min(1.0)   # predict dropped from context
   185	            L_anchor = ((1.0 - cos) * vis_m).sum() / vis_m.sum().clamp_min(1.0)
   186	            su = F.normalize(predictor((S * gvis.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(1)), dim=1)   # union identity token (predicted)
   187	            tu = F.normalize((T * gvis.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(1), dim=1)
   188	            L_union = (1.0 - (su * tu).sum(1)).mean()
   189	            vmask = gvis.reshape(-1).bool()                                 # v2-High: only visible-group tokens (drop zero-vectors)
   190	            Svis = S.reshape(-1, C)[vmask]
   191	            std_s = (Svis.std(0) * (C ** 0.5)) if Svis.shape[0] > 1 else torch.ones(C, device=DEV)  # ×√C: healthy≈1, collapse→0
   192	            L_var = F.relu(1.0 - std_s).mean()                              # target 1 now reachable
   193	            L_anc_sol = torch.zeros((), device=DEV)                         # Stage-B 防遗忘: visible token 蒸 frozen SOLIDER (防 forgetting)
   194	            if anchor is not None:
   195	                with torch.no_grad():
   196	                    A = fwd_tokens(anchor, x, gmask)                       # frozen SOLIDER full-view part tokens [B,G,C]
   197	                L_anc_sol = ((1.0 - (S * A).sum(2)) * vis_m).sum() / vis_m.sum().clamp_min(1.0)  # 可见区锚判别性
   198	            loss = (cli.w_jepa * L_jepa + cli.w_anchor * L_anchor + cli.w_union * L_union
   199	                    + cli.w_var * L_var + cli.w_solider_anchor * L_anc_sol)
   200	            opt.zero_grad(); loss.backward(); opt.step()
   201	            # EMA teacher update
   202	            with torch.no_grad():
   203	                for ps, pt in zip(student.parameters(), teacher.parameters()):
   204	                    pt.mul_(cli.ema).add_(ps.detach(), alpha=1 - cli.ema)
   205	            last = dict(L=loss.item(), jepa=L_jepa.item(), anchor=L_anchor.item(), union=L_union.item(),
   206	                        var=L_var.item(), sol=L_anc_sol.item(), tok_std=std_s.mean().item(),  # sol=防遗忘 anchor loss
   207	                        cos_drop=(cos * drop_m).sum().item() / drop_m.sum().clamp_min(1).item())
   208	            if it % 50 == 0:
   209	                print(f"  ep{ep} it{it}/{len(dl)} L={last['L']:.4f} jepa={last['jepa']:.4f} anchor={last['anchor']:.4f} "
   210	                      f"union={last['union']:.4f} var={last['var']:.4f} sol={last['sol']:.4f} tokStd={last['tok_std']:.3f} cosDrop={last['cos_drop']:.3f}", flush=True)
   211	        print(f"[epoch {ep}] " + " ".join(f"{k}={v:.4f}" for k, v in last.items()), flush=True)
   212	        if ((ep + 1) % cli.save_every == 0 or ep == cli.epochs - 1) and last:  # Low(r2): skip save if 0 update (empty/degenerate batch)
   213	            sd = {f"backbone.{k}": v for k, v in student.state_dict().items()}  # H1: backbone. prefix for downstream init_weights
   214	            torch.save({'state_dict': sd}, os.path.join(cli.repo, cli.out, f"pscjepa_{ep+1}.pth"))
   215	            print(f"[save] pscjepa_{ep+1}.pth ({len(sd)} keys, backbone. prefix)", flush=True)
   216	    print("[done] PSC-JEPA stage-A pretrain complete.")
   217	
   218	
   219	if __name__ == '__main__':
